I understand you want to restore your last git saved version because the errors won't end. Here's how to restore your last git commit:

## Step-by-step Git restore:

1. **Check your current git status:**
```bash
git status
```

2. **See your recent commits:**
```bash
git log --oneline -5
```

3. **Reset to your last working commit (hard reset - this will lose all current changes):**
```bash
git reset --hard HEAD
```

4. **Or if you want to go back to a specific commit:**
```bash
git reset --hard <commit-hash>
```

5. **If you want to keep your current changes but restore files:**
```bash
git checkout HEAD -- src/DrillingDashboard.js
```

6. **After restoring, restart your development server:**
```bash
npm start
```

## Alternative approach if you want to be safe:

1. **Stash your current changes first:**
```bash
git stash
```

2. **Then checkout the last working version:**
```bash
git checkout HEAD -- .
```

3. **If you want your changes back later:**
```bash
git stash pop
```

The `git reset --hard HEAD` command will completely restore your code to the last committed state and remove all the syntax errors. This is probably what you want since the errors are persisting.

                        {selectedOp.DrlgDays || 0}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Dry Days Actual */}
                <div style={{ flex: 1, background: '#23234c', color: 'white', borderRadius: 12, padding: '20px', minWidth: 200, minHeight: 140, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 12, textAlign: 'center', color: '#ba68c8' }}>Dry Days</div>
                  <div style={{ 
                    background: '#2e1a2f', 
                    borderRadius: 8, 
                    padding: '12px 16px', 
                    border: '2px solid #9c27b0', 
                    width: '100%', 
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s ease'
                  }}
                  onClick={() => startEditing('DryDays', selectedOp.DryDays || 0)}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => { e.target.style.borderColor = '#ba68c8'; }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => { e.target.style.borderColor = '#9c27b0'; }}
                  >
                    {editingField === 'DryDays' ? (
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={editingValue}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditingValue(e.target.value)}
                          style={{ 
                            fontSize: 18, 
                            fontWeight: 700, 
                            background: 'transparent', 
                            color: 'white', 
                            border: 'none', 
                            textAlign: 'center', 
                            width: '60px', 
                            outline: 'none' 
                          }}
                          autoFocus
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') confirmEdit('DryDays');
                            if (e.key === 'Escape') cancelEditing();
                          }}
                          onBlur={() => confirmEdit('DryDays')}
                        />
                        <button onClick={() => confirmEdit('DryDays')} style={{ background: '#4caf50', border: 'none', borderRadius: 3, color: 'white', padding: '2px 6px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }}>✓</button>
                        <button onClick={cancelEditing} style={{ background: '#f44336', border: 'none', borderRadius: 3, color: 'white', padding: '2px 6px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }}>✗</button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1, textAlign: 'center', color: 'white' }}>
                        {selectedOp.DryDays || 0}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Test Days */}
                <div style={{ flex: 1, background: '#23234c', color: 'white', borderRadius: 12, padding: '20px', minWidth: 200, minHeight: 140, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 12, textAlign: 'center', color: '#81c784' }}>Test Days</div>
                  <div style={{ 
                    background: '#1b3c2e', 
                    borderRadius: 8, 
                    padding: '12px 16px', 
                    border: '2px solid #4caf50', 
                    width: '100%', 
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s ease'
                  }}
                  onClick={() => startEditing('TestDays', selectedOp.TestDays || 0)}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => { e.target.style.borderColor = '#81c784'; }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => { e.target.style.borderColor = '#4caf50'; }}
                  >
                    {editingField === 'TestDays' ? (
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={editingValue}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditingValue(e.target.value)}
                          style={{ 
                            fontSize: 18, 
                            fontWeight: 700, 
                            background: 'transparent', 
                            color: 'white', 
                            border: 'none', 
                            textAlign: 'center', 
                            width: '60px', 
                            outline: 'none' 
                          }}
                          autoFocus
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') confirmEdit('TestDays');
                            if (e.key === 'Escape') cancelEditing();
                          }}
                          onBlur={() => confirmEdit('TestDays')}
                        />
                        <button onClick={() => confirmEdit('TestDays')} style={{ background: '#4caf50', border: 'none', borderRadius: 3, color: 'white', padding: '2px 6px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }}>✓</button>
                        <button onClick={cancelEditing} style={{ background: '#f44336', border: 'none', borderRadius: 3, color: 'white', padding: '2px 6px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }}>✗</button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1, textAlign: 'center', color: 'white' }}>
                        {selectedOp.TestDays || 0}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Test WO Days */}
                <div style={{ flex: 1, background: '#23234c', color: 'white', borderRadius: 12, padding: '20px', minWidth: 200, minHeight: 140, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 12, textAlign: 'center', color: '#ffb74d' }}>Test WO Days</div>
                  <div style={{ 
                    background: '#4d3a1a', 
                    borderRadius: 8, 
                    padding: '12px 16px', 
                    border: '2px solid #ff9800', 
                    width: '100%', 
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s ease'
                  }}
                  onClick={() => startEditing('TestWODays', selectedOp.TestWODays || 0)}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => { e.target.style.borderColor = '#ffb74d'; }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => { e.target.style.borderColor = '#ff9800'; }}
                  >
                    {editingField === 'TestWODays' ? (
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={editingValue}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditingValue(e.target.value)}
                          style={{ 
                            fontSize: 18, 
                            fontWeight: 700, 
                            background: 'transparent', 
                            color: 'white', 
                            border: 'none', 
                            textAlign: 'center', 
                            width: '60px', 
                            outline: 'none' 
                          }}
                          autoFocus
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') confirmEdit('TestWODays');
                            if (e.key === 'Escape') cancelEditing();
                          }}
                          onBlur={() => confirmEdit('TestWODays')}
                        />
                        <button onClick={() => confirmEdit('TestWODays')} style={{ background: '#4caf50', border: 'none', borderRadius: 3, color: 'white', padding: '2px 6px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }}>✓</button>
                        <button onClick={cancelEditing} style={{ background: '#f44336', border: 'none', borderRadius: 3, color: 'white', padding: '2px 6px', fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer' }}>✗</button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (

                        {selectedOp.TestWODays || 0}

                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Visualization Section (Frontend-only, using recharts) */}
              <div style={{ margin: '40px 0', display: 'flex', gap: 32, justifyContent: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <WellCharts
                  pieChartData={pieChartData}
                  barChartData={barChartData}
                  testBarChartData={testBarChartData}
                />
              </div>
